title: aaas.successor.called.v1
description: Published by successor once per computation of n + 1 for a task, after the call is recorded in its call log. Audit trail of the Peano arithmetic: an addition a + b produces b of these events. No service consumes it yet.

producer.description: The only service allowed to publish this event (contracts/events/topics.psv).

taskId.description: Addition task the call was made for; never null for this event.

payload.description: The argument and the result of one successor computation.

n.description: Argument of the call: a natural number from 0 to 199 997, so that the result is a possible sum.

result.description: The successor of n, always n + 1.
